# R1 vectors attribution

`groups-vectors.json`, `class-vectors.json` and `holders-vectors.json` are
reproduced **without changes** from the public specification at tag `v0.1.49`,
commit `1c3bcafc8bfc1450c3c0cefb69a122f6a97a448e`:

- [LIP-0026 groups](https://github.com/relux-works/swarma-link-spec/blob/1c3bcafc8bfc1450c3c0cefb69a122f6a97a448e/vectors/LIP-0026/groups-vectors.json).
- [LIP-0026 landlord class](https://github.com/relux-works/swarma-link-spec/blob/1c3bcafc8bfc1450c3c0cefb69a122f6a97a448e/vectors/LIP-0026/class-vectors.json).
- [LIP-0010 holders](https://github.com/relux-works/swarma-link-spec/blob/1c3bcafc8bfc1450c3c0cefb69a122f6a97a448e/vectors/LIP-0010/holders-vectors.json).

licensed with this repository. It is not an upstream normative vector file.
